name: Santos Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Education Scholarship (UQ)
summary: Multi-year scholarship for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander UQ coursework students facing financial hardship.
key: $10,000 Full-Time / $5,000 Part-Time, for up to four years.
who: Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person.
Enrolled in any coursework program in the semester of the award.
how: Apply using the online application form. One application covers the Aspire, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Education and UQ Residential scholarship schemes.
catches: Applications opened 17 August 2026 and close 26 February 2027.

evidence.quote: are an Australian Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person
